exports.source:
la $s0, values
    la $t0, count
    lw $s1, 0($t0)
    la $t0, algorithm
    lw $s7, 0($t0)
    move $s6, $zero
    la $t0, swap_count
    sw $zero, 0($t0)
    la $t0, phase
    sw $zero, 0($t0)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop

la $t0, dx
    daddu $t0, $t0, $a0
    lb $t1, 0($t0)
    addu $t1, $t1, $a1
    sltiu $t2, $t1, 8
    beq $t2, $zero, next_neighbor
    nop
    la $t0, dy
    daddu $t0, $t0, $a0
    lb $t2, 0($t0)
    addu $t2, $t2, $a2
    sltiu $t3, $t2, 8
    beq $t3, $zero, next_neighbor
    nop
    sll $t3, $t2, 3
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1

li $v0, -4
    lbu $t1, 3($a0)
    andi $t9, $t1, 0xfe
    bne $t9, $zero, packet_return
    nop

beq $s4, $zero, done
    nop
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s2
    jal advance_axis
    nop
    move $s0, $v0
    move $s2, $v1

addiu $t1, $t1, 4
    sltu $t9, $t1, $a3
    bne $t9, $zero, next_tile
    nop
    addiu $t0, $t0, 4
    sltu $t9, $t0, $a2
    bne $t9, $zero, next_tile_row
    nop

west_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x30($s0)
    bne $t2, $zero, west_wait
    nop
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
west_stopped:

la $a0, signed_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 1
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
signed_printed:

move $t3, $zero
    lbu $t1, -11($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, -10($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, -9($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, -1($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 1($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 9($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 10($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
    lbu $t1, 11($s7)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t1
neighbors_counted:
# mars:tool bitmap width=64 height=64 unitWidth=32 unitHeight=32 base=static_data

la $t0, frame
    la $t1, walls
    la $t2, states
    la $t3, path
    li $t4, 64
render_cell:
    li $t5, 0x202020
    lbu $t6, 0($t1)
    bne $t6, $zero, render_store
    nop
    li $t5, 0x0072b2
    lbu $t6, 0($t3)
    bne $t6, $zero, render_store
    nop
    li $t5, 0xffffff
    lbu $t6, 0($t2)
    beq $t6, $zero, render_store
    nop
    li $t5, 0xe69f00
    li $t7, 1
    beq $t6, $t7, render_store
    nop
    li $t5, 0x009e73
render_store:
    sw $t5, 0($t0)

li $t0, 2
    la $t1, phase
    sw $t0, 0($t1)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop

li $v0, -1
    move $v1, $zero
    sltiu $t9, $a1, 8
    bne $t9, $zero, packet_return
    nop

move $s2, $zero
selection_outer:
    addiu $t0, $s1, -1
    slt $t0, $s2, $t0
    beq $t0, $zero, sort_end
    nop
    move $s4, $s2
    addiu $s3, $s2, 1

south_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x40($s0)
    bne $t2, $s1, south_wait
    nop
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
south_stopped:

move $t0, $a0
    li $t1, 64
clear_pixel:
    sw $zero, 0($t0)
    daddiu $t0, $t0, 4
    addiu $t1, $t1, -1
    bne $t1, $zero, clear_pixel
    nop

xori $t4, $t3, 3
    sltiu $t4, $t4, 1
    xori $t5, $t3, 2
    sltiu $t5, $t5, 1
    lbu $t6, 0($s7)
    and $t5, $t5, $t6
    or $t4, $t4, $t5
rule_decided:

la $t0, result
    li $t1, 1
    sw $t1, 0($t0)
    daddu $t0, $s3, $s7
    lbu $t1, 0($t0)
    la $t0, length
    sw $t1, 0($t0)
    move $t0, $s7
    la $t1, path
    la $t2, start
    lw $t2, 0($t2)
    li $t3, 1

li $t0, 1792
    slt $t1, $v0, $t0
    bne $t1, $zero, axis_return
    nop
    li $t0, 3584
    subu $v0, $t0, $v0
    subu $v1, $zero, $v1

move $t3, $zero
    slt $t4, $t2, $a1
    beq $t4, $zero, render_store
    nop
    sll $t4, $t2, 2
    daddu $t4, $a0, $t4
    lw $t5, 0($t4)
    addiu $t5, $t5, 5
    li $t6, 8
    subu $t5, $t6, $t5
    slt $t6, $t1, $t5
    bne $t6, $zero, render_store
    nop
    li $t3, 0x00ffffff
render_store:
    sw $t3, 0($t0)
    daddiu $t0, $t0, 4

north_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x40($s0)
    bne $t2, $zero, north_wait
    nop
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
north_stopped:

slt $t1, $s2, $s0
    bne $t1, $zero, swap_endpoints
    nop
    bne $s0, $s2, ordered
    nop
    slt $t1, $s3, $s1
    beq $t1, $zero, ordered
    nop
swap_endpoints:
    move $t1, $s0
    move $s0, $s2
    move $s2, $t1
    move $t1, $s1
    move $s1, $s3
    move $s3, $t1
ordered:

dla $s7, frame
    dla $t0, seed_x
    lw $s0, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, seed_y
    lw $s1, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, seed_vx
    lw $s2, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, seed_vy
    lw $s3, 0($t0)

li $s4, 1
cell_row:
    li $s5, 1
cell_loop:
    sll $t0, $s4, 3
    sll $t1, $s4, 1
    addu $t0, $t0, $t1
    addu $t0, $t0, $s5
    daddu $s7, $s0, $t0
    daddu $t7, $s1, $t0

beq $s3, $zero, insertion_next
    nop
    sll $t0, $s3, 2
    daddu $t0, $s0, $t0
    lw $t1, -4($t0)
    lw $t2, 0($t0)
    slt $t3, $t2, $t1
    beq $t3, $zero, insertion_next
    nop

daddu $t4, $t1, $t0
    sb $t3, 0($t4)
    beq $t0, $t2, finished
    nop
    daddu $t4, $s2, $t0
    lbu $t0, 0($t4)
    j path_loop
    nop

next_tile_row:
    move $t1, $zero
next_tile:
    addiu $t2, $t0, 4
    sltu $t9, $a2, $t2
    beq $t9, $zero, row_end_ready
    nop
    move $t2, $a2
row_end_ready:

daddiu $t0, $t0, 4
    daddiu $t1, $t1, 1
    daddiu $t2, $t2, 1
    daddiu $t3, $t3, 1
    addiu $t4, $t4, -1
    bne $t4, $zero, render_cell
    nop

la $t0, head
    sw $s5, 0($t0)
    la $t0, tail
    sw $s6, 0($t0)
    la $t0, current
    sw $s7, 0($t0)
    li $t1, 2
    la $t0, phase
    sw $t1, 0($t0)
    jal render
    nop

beq $s4, $s2, selection_next
    nop
    sll $t0, $s2, 2
    daddu $t0, $s0, $t0
    lw $t1, 0($t0)
    sll $t2, $s4, 2
    daddu $t2, $s0, $t2
    lw $t3, 0($t2)
    sw $t3, 0($t0)
    sw $t1, 0($t2)
selection_swapped:
    addiu $s6, $s6, 1
    la $t0, swap_count
    sw $s6, 0($t0)
    li $t0, 1
    la $t1, phase
    sw $t0, 0($t1)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop

daddu $t0, $s0, $t3
    lbu $t1, 0($t0)
    bne $t1, $zero, next_neighbor
    nop
    daddu $t0, $s1, $t3
    lbu $t1, 0($t0)
    bne $t1, $zero, next_neighbor
    nop

addiu $t2, $t2, 1
    slti $t4, $t2, 8
    bne $t4, $zero, render_cell
    nop
    addiu $t1, $t1, 1
    slti $t4, $t1, 8
    bne $t4, $zero, render_row
    nop

addiu $s5, $s5, 1
    slti $t0, $s5, 9
    bne $t0, $zero, cell_loop
    nop
    addiu $s4, $s4, 1
    slti $t0, $s4, 9
    bne $t0, $zero, cell_row
    nop
generation_computed:

li $t6, 0
    and $t5, $t8, $t4
    beq $t5, $zero, write_mirror
    nop
    li $t6, 0x00ffffff
write_mirror:
    sw $t6, 0($t7)
pair_written:

bgtz $v0, axis_above_low
    nop
    subu $v0, $zero, $v0
    subu $v1, $zero, $v1
    jr $ra
    nop
axis_above_low:

la $t0, start
    lw $t1, 0($t0)
    sb $t1, 0($s4)
    daddu $t2, $s1, $t1
    li $t3, 1
    sb $t3, 0($t2)
    daddu $t2, $s3, $t1
    sb $zero, 0($t2)
    li $t3, -1
    la $t0, result
    sw $t3, 0($t0)
    la $t0, length
    sw $t3, 0($t0)

daddu $t2, $t2, $t7
    daddiu $t4, $t4, 4
    addiu $t0, $t0, 1
    sltu $t9, $t0, $a2
    bne $t9, $zero, naive_row
    nop

la $s0, walls
    la $s1, states
    la $s2, parents
    la $s3, distance
    la $s4, queue
    move $s5, $zero
    li $s6, 1
    li $s7, -1
    move $t0, $zero
    li $t1, 255
    la $t2, path

li $v0, -3
    lbu $t7, 2($a0)
    li $t9, 1
    bne $t7, $t9, packet_return
    nop

sll $t6, $a2, 2
    sll $t7, $a3, 2
    move $t0, $zero
    move $t2, $a0
    move $t4, $a1
naive_row:
    move $t1, $zero
    move $t3, $t2
    move $t5, $t4

move $a0, $s1
    move $a1, $s3
    jal advance_axis
    nop
    move $s1, $v0
    move $s3, $v1

la $a0, unsigned_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 36
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
unsigned_printed:

la $t0, frame
    move $t1, $zero
render_row:
    move $t2, $zero
render_cell:

addiu $t8, $t0, 9
    li $v0, -1
    sltu $t9, $a1, $t8
    bne $t9, $zero, packet_return
    nop

slt $t0, $s3, $s1
    beq $t0, $zero, selection_exchange
    nop
    sll $t0, $s4, 2
    daddu $t0, $s0, $t0
    lw $t1, 0($t0)
    sll $t2, $s3, 2
    daddu $t2, $s0, $t2
    lw $t3, 0($t2)
    slt $t4, $t3, $t1
    beq $t4, $zero, selection_keep
    nop
    move $s4, $s3
selection_keep:
    addiu $s3, $s3, 1
    beq $zero, $zero, selection_scan
    nop

la $t0, sprite
    la $t1, sprite_end
    la $s0, frame
    la $s1, mirrored_rows

prompt:  .asciiz "Enter a small integer: "
answer:  .asciiz "Twice your number plus one is: "
newline: .asciiz "\n"

lbu $t4, 0($t0)
    subu $t4, $zero, $t4
    and $t4, $t4, $t5
    sw $t4, 0($t1)
    daddiu $t0, $t0, 1
    daddiu $t1, $t1, 4

addiu $t3, $t3, -1
    bne $t3, $zero, seed_cell
    nop
    daddiu $t1, $t1, 2
    addiu $t2, $t2, -1
    bne $t2, $zero, seed_row
    nop
seed_copied:

li $s6, 1
    bgez $s5, absolute_ready
    nop
    subu $s5, $zero, $s5
    li $s6, -1
absolute_ready:

sw $t2, -4($t0)
    sw $t1, 0($t0)
insertion_swapped:
    addiu $s3, $s3, -1
    addiu $s6, $s6, 1
    la $t0, swap_count
    sw $s6, 0($t0)
    li $t0, 1
    la $t1, phase
    sw $t0, 0($t1)
    move $a0, $s0
    move $a1, $s1
    jal render
    nop
    beq $zero, $zero, insertion_inner
    nop

east_wait:
    lw $t2, 0x30($s0)
    bne $t2, $s1, east_wait
    nop
east_stop:
    sw $zero, 0x50($s0)
east_stopped:

bne $s0, $s2, advance
    nop
    beq $s1, $s3, done
    nop
advance:

addiu $t3, $t1, 4
    sltu $t9, $a3, $t3
    beq $t9, $zero, column_end_ready
    nop
    move $t3, $a3
column_end_ready:
    move $t4, $t0

lbu $t7, 0($t5)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t7
    daddiu $t5, $t5, 1
    addiu $t6, $t6, -1
    bne $t6, $zero, header_sum
    nop

beq $s7, $zero, insertion_sort
    nop
    beq $zero, $zero, selection_sort
    nop

move $t2, $a1
    move $t3, $a2
    beq $a3, $zero, quantize
    nop
    addiu $t2, $t2, 128
    addiu $t3, $t3, 128
quantize:

la $t0, head
    sw $s5, 0($t0)
    la $t0, tail
    sw $s6, 0($t0)
    la $t0, current
    sw $s7, 0($t0)
    li $t1, 1
    la $t0, phase
    sw $t1, 0($t0)
    jal render
    nop
    la $t0, goal
    lw $t1, 0($t0)
    beq $s7, $t1, found
    nop
    j search
    nop

slt $t3, $t2, $s5
    bne $t3, $zero, skip_x
    nop
    addu $s7, $s7, $s5
    addiu $s0, $s0, 1
skip_x:

clear_cell:
    daddu $t3, $s1, $t0
    sb $zero, 0($t3)
    daddu $t3, $s2, $t0
    sb $t1, 0($t3)
    daddu $t3, $s3, $t0
    sb $t1, 0($t3)
    daddu $t3, $s4, $t0
    sb $zero, 0($t3)
    daddu $t3, $t2, $t0
    sb $zero, 0($t3)
    addiu $t0, $t0, 1
    sltiu $t3, $t0, 64
    bne $t3, $zero, clear_cell
    nop

move $a0, $s7
    move $a1, $s0
    move $a2, $s1
    move $a3, $s6
    jal render_ball
    nop
    dla $t0, pixel_id
    sw $v0, 0($t0)

li $t1, 1
    sb $t1, 0($t0)
    daddu $t0, $s2, $t3
    sb $s7, 0($t0)
    daddu $t0, $s3, $s7
    lbu $t1, 0($t0)
    addiu $t1, $t1, 1
    daddu $t0, $s3, $t3
    sb $t1, 0($t0)

addiu $t3, $t3, -1
    bne $t3, $zero, render_cell
    nop
    daddiu $t0, $t0, 2
    addiu $t2, $t2, -1
    bne $t2, $zero, render_row
    nop
    la $t0, generation
    sw $s3, 0($t0)
generation_ready:

column_loop:
    li $t6, 0
    and $t5, $t3, $t4
    beq $t5, $zero, write_normal
    nop
    li $t6, 0x00ffffff
write_normal:
    sw $t6, 0($t2)

mul $v0, $a2, $a3
    beq $a2, $zero, naive_return
    nop
    beq $a3, $zero, naive_return
    nop

lbu $t7, 0($t5)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t7
    andi $t3, $t3, 255
    li $v0, -6
    bne $t3, $zero, packet_return
    nop

la $t8, frame
    la $t0, color
    lw $t9, 0($t0)
line_loop:

la $a0, hex_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 34
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
hex_printed:

slt $t3, $s4, $t2
    bne $t3, $zero, skip_y
    nop
    addu $s7, $s7, $s4
    addu $s1, $s1, $s6
skip_y:

li $v0, -2
    lbu $t7, 0($a0)
    li $t9, 0x4d
    bne $t7, $t9, packet_return
    nop
    lbu $t7, 1($a0)
    li $t9, 0x50
    bne $t7, $t9, packet_return
    nop

la $a0, binary_msg
    li $v0, 4
    syscall
    move $a0, $s0
    li $v0, 35
    syscall
    la $a0, newline
    li $v0, 4
    syscall

lbu $t7, 0($t5)
    addu $t3, $t3, $t7
    addu $t4, $t4, $t7
    daddiu $t5, $t5, 1
    addiu $t6, $t6, -1
    bne $t6, $zero, payload_sum
    nop

mul $v0, $a2, $a3
    beq $a2, $zero, tiled_return
    nop
    beq $a3, $zero, tiled_return
    nop
    sll $v1, $a2, 2
    move $t0, $zero

addiu $t5, $t5, 1
    sltu $t9, $t5, $t3
    bne $t9, $zero, next_tiled_column
    nop
    addiu $t4, $t4, 1
    sltu $t9, $t4, $t2
    bne $t9, $zero, next_tiled_row
    nop

dla $t0, steps
    lw $s4, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, round_mode
    lw $s6, 0($t0)
    move $s5, $zero

beq $s5, $s6, unreachable
    nop
    daddu $t0, $s4, $s5
    lbu $s7, 0($t0)
    addiu $s5, $s5, 1
    daddu $t0, $s1, $s7
    li $t1, 2
    sb $t1, 0($t0)
    la $t0, goal
    lw $t1, 0($t0)
    beq $s7, $t1, expanded
    nop
    andi $a1, $s7, 7
    srl $a2, $s7, 3
    move $a0, $zero

li $s2, 1
insertion_outer:
    slt $t0, $s2, $s1
    beq $t0, $zero, sort_end
    nop
    move $s3, $s2

la $t0, endpoints
    lw $s0, 0($t0)
    lw $s1, 4($t0)
    lw $s2, 8($t0)
    lw $s3, 12($t0)
inputs_loaded:

la $s0, board_a
    la $s1, board_b
    la $t0, generations
    lw $s2, 0($t0)
    move $s3, $zero

dla $t0, x_raw
    sw $s0, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, y_raw
    sw $s1, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, vx_raw
    sw $s2, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, vy_raw
    sw $s3, 0($t0)
    dla $t0, tick
    sw $s5, 0($t0)

la $t0, seed
    daddiu $t1, $s0, 11
    li $t2, 8
seed_row:
    li $t3, 8
seed_cell:

la $t0, head
    sw $s5, 0($t0)
    la $t0, tail
    sw $s6, 0($t0)
    la $t0, current
    sw $s7, 0($t0)
    li $t1, 0
    la $t0, phase
    sw $t1, 0($t0)
    jal render
    nop

render:
    daddiu $t0, $s0, 11
    la $t1, frame
    li $t2, 8
    li $t5, 0x00ffffff
render_row:
    li $t3, 8
render_cell:
